name: How do I know if storm-damaged drywall can be repaired or if it has to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if storm-damaged drywall can be repaired or if it has to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: You usually need replacement when drywall is saturated, bowed, moldy, or damaged beyond a small surface area. In Denver-area homes, the key question is whether the wallboard dried completely and kept its shape; if not, patching may fail and the finished wall can show stains, seams, or lingering odor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small cosmetic damage may be repairable, but saturated, warped, moldy, or collapsing drywall usually needs replacement. A professional inspection helps determine whether the wallboard is still structurally sound and dry enough to save.
